outcome.technical: ONE ANSWER: _evidence_io.newest_or_unreadable(rows, unreadable, scope, subject, aliases, latest) returns {row, rows, unreadable, sentence}; a subject whose own lastRun is not the schema's shape answers no row and a sentence naming file and field. Reconcile loops subjects through it: such a subject is REFUSED (run-test-gate prints `REFUSED:` and exits 1), its record and pointer are left byte-identical, every other subject is reconciled as before; _reconciled re-reads under the plan-file lock and refuses the same way; held full-run records that do not read are printed as UNREAD and exit 1, never folded into a subject. The same function answers audit-lookup `run latest` (a miss naming the record; a miss also names unread plan records), the doctor's pointer check (_doctor_completions: no dangling/behind finding for such a subject, a warning naming it instead), the verdict binding's unreadable arm (subject_record_lost removed, no callers) and derive-phase-gate (REFUSED, E_INVALID, before deriving last-failed suites). validate-manifest's suite check says 'not established' when plan records do not read. nu6 derives every picker from the AST and fails one that picks a newest run without the function, with _NU_LEFT naming the rest (each row checked stale both ways) and its blind spot stated. BINDING BEHAVIOUR CHANGE: a base run kept on a task's red (scope base, phaseId set) was counted as the phase's run by _same_subject; now excluded, identity otherwise unchanged (_same_subject) - a first attempt keyed the binding by subject_key and broke ctw46 (a task's run on its phase's gate records scope phase beside taskId); reverted to _same_subject minus base-scope rows, m7b mutation proves ctw46 holds it. SHARES: _NEVER_SHARED renamed NEVER_SHARED_KEYS, read by the writer (_shared_paths) and the reader (share_problem): a share naming a never-shared top key, or a path the record also holds, does not read; validate-manifest warns the same (rules.schema.share, a warning in 3.x). The writer DOES share testedState on part and whole repeats; ns3 shows a planted testedState share binds exactly as a hand-written one and a carried run of other bytes is refused. SCHEMA: lastRun.repeatedRun -> $ref lastRun; baseRed typed object with baseRuns array of lastRun (rr1-rr3, a warning in 3.x). RELEASE GUARD (.claude/hooks/guard-release.py, edits accepted, no refusal): plan_structure_problem refuses duplicate keys (object_pairs_hook, index and every shard), meta not object, phases not list (absent = []), phase/task entry not object, tasks not list; read_bugs refuses bugs not list / bug entry not object; read_held_phases refuses evidence_io.full_gate_problem and a mergedHead with no placeable mergedAt; _deny exits 2 when the stdout write fails (stderr attempted, each guarded by BaseException). arm-release-bypass: _load_guard, open_bugs, held_phases catch BaseException (rb21). Docs: SECURITY.md (guard section + table header), CHANGELOG.md Fixed (four bullets), PLUGIN-BUILD-GUIDE.md reconcile paragraph + NEVER_SHARED_KEYS rename; guard docstring exit-code line corrected (it said 'exit 0 always'). Also fixed in my own test file: ri8 fixture planted a steps share beside held steps (now refused by share_problem) - share list trimmed; rk2 text renamed; nu5 run ids renamed off a register-citation shape (rc16). Gates: gate command as given exit 0/0 (8/8 files, 1714 cases); full sweep after the last edit 198/198 files, 19650 cases, exit 0. Pre-filing: suite list (30 files) green after fixes; gate-parity, bench-hooks --gate, check-rendered-artifacts --before-commit, check-example-ledgers, check-git-pipeline, measure-context --gate, ruff, vermin all exit 0; _deps --write-map wrote nothing new.
